declared.rule: While a Learn campaign waits for verified Weave evidence, FaultLab retries the evidence by itself at most 3 times per wait and at most 6 times per campaign: 30 s, 120 s and 300 s after the wait starts or after the previous retry still left the evidence unverified. Each automatic retry uses the same telemetry-only path as Retry evidence sync: it re-sends the saved trace records of the episodes the wait needs and reads them back. It never runs an episode, a business tool or a model request again, and charges nothing to the campaign budget. Every attempt is recorded. When a limit is reached the campaign keeps waiting and shows "needs operator"; Retry evidence sync and Stop still work. A stop during the wait ends the campaign as STOPPED.

message: This campaign is not waiting for evidence.
